name: @raven/egress-worker
description: Live Streaming broadcast redesign: standalone worker that joins a BROADCAST-mode stream headlessly (as an ordinary, internal, publish:false viewer, over the real @ravenkash/client join path), transcodes the host's real media to HLS via ffmpeg, and uploads segments/manifest to Azure Blob Storage behind Azure Front Door/CDN.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/harness/vendor && cp src/harness/viewer.html dist/harness/viewer.html && cp -r src/harness/vendor/. dist/harness/vendor/
